title: 2030. Smallest K-Length Subsequence With Occurrences of a Letter

examples.explanation: There are four subsequences of length 3 that have the letter 'e' appear at least 1 time: - "lee" (from "leet") - "let" (from "leet") - "let" (from "leet") - "eet" (from "leet") The lexicographically smallest subsequence among them is "eet".
"ecde" is the lexicographically smallest subsequence of length 4 that has the letter "e" appear at least 2 times.
"bb" is the only subsequence of length 2 that has the letter "b" appear at least 2 times.
